info.description: Accept stablecoin and Bitcoin payments and settle in naira. Use a lmp_test_ key with the Sandbox server and a lmp_live_ key with the Live server.

post.description: Sends naira from your balance to your verified bank account. Omit `amountNgn` to pay out everything available. Only one payout can be in progress at a time. Large or unusual payouts can need a second approval or the owner's selfie (`403 SELFIE_REQUIRED`); an instant payout carries a fee (see `GET /payouts/rules`). Payouts go only to a bank account in your own verified name.

post.description:
A refund is a new payment back to the wallet that paid, in the same coin. LuminPay's fee is not refunded and LuminPay pays the network fee. The customer never receives more coins than they paid: if the rate moved 1% or less, or in the customer's favour, they get exactly the coins they paid; if the naira got more than 1% weaker, they get the naira price in coins at today's rate (fewer coins). You are debited the naira you were credited either way.

Requires an owner, admin or manager signed in to the dashboard, and their PIN. Above your approval limit a second owner or admin must approve it; a business can also hold refunds before sending. Check the result in `merchantApprovalStatus`, `scheduledFor` and `status`. Get a quote first with `GET .../quote`.

amount.description: Coins to refund, in the coin's smallest unit, as a string.

expectedSendAmount.description: The `sendAmount` from the quote you showed. If the rate moved and it would change, the request is refused with 409 `REFUND_QUOTE_CHANGED` and the new amount.

409.description: The rate moved since the quote (`REFUND_QUOTE_CHANGED`), or the Idempotency-Key is still in use.

503.description: The exchange rate is unavailable, so the refund cannot be priced. Try again in a few minutes.

destAmountNgn.description: Naira sent to your bank account, for example "49,500.00".

PayoutRules.description: Payout terms. Amounts are in naira.

dailyMinimumNgn.description: Balance needed for the automatic daily payout.

amount.description: Coins the sale is reduced by, in the coin's smallest unit.

sendAmount.description: Coins actually sent. Never more than amount. Less when the naira got more than 1% weaker since the sale.

destinationAddress.description: The wallet that paid. Refunds cannot go anywhere else.

merchantApprovalStatus.description: `pending` means a second owner or admin must approve it.

scheduledFor.description: When a hold ends and the refund is sent.

moveBps.description: How far the market rate moved against the customer since the sale, in basis points.

merchantDebitKobo.description: Naira taken from your balance, in kobo.

expiresAt.description: The quote is valid for 5 minutes.

approvalLimitKobo.description: Refunds above this need a second owner or admin. Default 25000000 (₦250,000).

holdMinutes.description: Hold before sending. 0 means send at once.

IdempotencyConflict.description: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still being processed. Wait a moment and retry.

IdempotencyMismatch.description: This Idempotency-Key was already used for a different request. Use a new key for a different request.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A unique value for this request, 8 to 64 characters (letters, numbers, dots, dashes, underscores, colons). Send the same value when retrying: the first answer is returned with the header `Idempotent-Replayed: true` and nothing is created twice. Kept for 24 hours. The same key with a different request returns 422; the same key while the first request is still running returns 409.
